title: [Installer] Sign and validate Windows Runtime metadata

proposed_comments.title: Check the affected filename in the missing-version diagnostic assertion
proposed_comments.body:
### Check the affected filename in the missing-version diagnostic assertion

**Severity:** `low` (non-blocking test coverage)

The existing `-contains` check correctly matches the separate prefix argument passed to `Write-Host`; it is not a broken substring check. Please also assert that the same call contains the fixture's full filename. Currently the test still passes if the missing-version diagnostic names a different file.

This keeps the existing output and PowerShell argument-array semantics unchanged. The literal change passes all 25 tests in `versionAndSignCheck.Tests.ps1` under Pester 3.4 on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7. A mutation replacing only the reported filename with `wrong-file.dll` passes the original suite but fails both missing-version cases with this assertion.

```suggestion
        Assert-MockCalled Write-Host -Scope It -ParameterFilter { ($Object -contains 'Version not set: ') -and ($Object -contains $fixture.Files[0].FullName) }
```

confidence.rationale: Exact-current-source dual-shell tests and a wrong-filename mutation demonstrate the narrow assertion gap; no production signing failure is alleged.
